caption: The drawing depicts a standing figure, possibly a person, shown from head to just below the knees, with unfinished pencil marks extending below the feet. The figure is dressed in a light brown tunic-like garment with a yellow hem and white trim, and green footwear. The figure wears a yellow headband with three large feathers: two green and one pink or red, sticking upward and outward. The figure's hair appears dark, possibly black or very dark brown, and falls around the shoulders. The face and exposed arms and legs have a reddish-brown hue. The figure holds a tall, white staff or stick in the left hand and a red rectangular object in the crook of the right arm, with the hand resting atop the object. Behind the figure’s right arm, a circular or oval shape resembling a shield is partially visible in a faint, rose color. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a solid off-white or cream color. There are no additional objects or scenery in the composition.
title: Tradesman's Sign (Indian)
